target_customer: Small and medium businesses and social sellers in India who want their own e-commerce site and native mobile app
problem: Small Indian merchants sell through mobile and social channels but lack an affordable way to run their own store and publish native apps to the Google Play and Apple app stores.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for e-commerce site and app builder
product_category: E-commerce and mobile app builder for SMBs

founders.name: Shubham Agrawal
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page, which also shows him later as founder of Tulika AI. No other bio found.

founders.name: Dhilbar Roshan
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on the YC page; no bio.

exit.reason: Cause not public. Dealroom lists the company as closed; no company statement found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Template e-commerce storefronts plus automated generation and publishing of native Android and iOS apps is standard engineering with store submission complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Website and app builders are widely available and the product was copyable by larger platforms and local rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found; the company's fate is not documented.

market_need_then: Not independently sourced; the company positioned itself around Indian small businesses moving to mobile first commerce.

branding.domain_note: Used mynamaste.in rather than a .com; no source on how it was obtained.

brand_strength.rationale: Searches surface unrelated businesses with the same name and no press on this brand; the generic Hindi greeting made it easy to confuse.

outcome_analysis: Namaste Business offered Indian small businesses an e-commerce site and native app builder and joined YC in Summer 2019 with a small team. Public data is very thin: databases report only small funding of about 290 thousand dollars and conflict on whether the company is alive or closed. The cause of the inactive status is not public, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: mynamaste.in did not resolve from this session, so the site is treated as unreachable (possibly dead), not confirmed dead. CB Insights shows $290K over 2 rounds with a pre-seed dated 2024-02-09 and investors Antler and Google for Startups Accelerator; its round amount is not stated, so amount is null. Dealroom shows a $125K seed. Both rounds rest on single databases and are unverified; the CB Insights financials page returned 403. Status conflict: CB Insights says Alive, Dealroom says closed. No dated competitor sources were found near the 2019 batch; list left empty. Founder education and prior employers not found.
